correctness.rationale: The weighted one-pattern cluster identity F=C/[(1-zT)C+z^mW] is valid. For q>=3 and m>=2 a connector letter other than the forbidden first/last letters ensures a primitive allowed de Bruijn graph. The Perron root lies strictly between 1/q and 1/2; implicit derivatives show differences of limiting letter frequencies equal a negative scalar times sum over borders rho^(m-ell) d_ell. At the longest differing border d>=1, shorter-border changes are bounded by missing prefix letters, giving the strict bound 1-rho^2/(1-rho)^2>0. This proves the reversed sign, all pairwise ties and the uniform case, with m=1 handled separately.
